exposure: first trimester pre-eclampsia screening using the Fetal Medicine Foundation (FMF) algorithm
first trimester pre-eclampsia screening using the Fetal Medicine Foundation (FMF) algorithm and targeted aspirin prophylaxis
outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
cohort: 5957 pregnancies screened for pre-eclampsia using the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) method at a London tertiary hospital
finding: The FMF algorithm was associated with seven fewer cases of preterm pre-eclampsia, cost saving of £9.06 and QALY gain of 0.00006/pregnancy screened compared to the NICE method.
